title: Epic Chests
intro: Epic Chests are diamond chests costing 29 diamonds each (formerly known as Rare Chests). They guarantee both a purple-rarity puzzle piece and an exclusive animal puzzle piece with every opening.
obtaining_body: Epic Chests can be obtained from several sources: quests, leveling up, monthly login rewards, and the Zoo Academy.
contents_body: Epic Chests contain puzzle pieces from Friendship and Normal Chests, but do not include the exclusive animals from those chests. Every Epic Chest guarantees at least one purple-rarity puzzle piece and at least one exclusive animal puzzle piece.
drop_bonus_body: Epic Chests feature a rotating drop bonus that boosts the chance of receiving a specific exclusive animal's puzzle pieces. The boosted animal changes every 6 weeks, rotating through the exclusive animal list.
animals_body: The following animals are exclusive to Epic Chests and cannot be obtained through any other chest type:
tips_body: Epic Chests are the most affordable diamond chest at 29 diamonds and offer guaranteed exclusive animal puzzle pieces with every opening. The drop bonus rotates every 6 weeks — check the current bonus animal if you are working toward a specific collection. At this price point, Epic Chests are excellent value for players who want to progress efficiently on exclusive animal collections.
